_descriptor_type: A type of descriptor. One of 'simulation', 'trace', and 'perf'.
_architecture: src/PARAMS.<architecture> at the binary's commit (sci also wants it in scarab_path's checkout).
_experiment: Second-seed controls for sierra.a.4, whiskey, delta of mlp_oracle_google_defmark: its lru and controls, drawn with --mlp_oracle_seed 1. They replay the study's reference, so run them where its records are. lru must equal the main study's. Generated by tools/mlp_oracle/seed_descriptor.py.
_workload_manager: manual: run the simulations on this machine, at most max_parallel at a time.
_max_parallel: run_study.sh sets this at launch from idle cores, free memory and your other runs.
_container_reuse: One reused container per slot instead of one per sim.
_root_dir: Output goes to <root_dir>/simulations/<experiment>. The reference and the replay runs must share it.
_application_dir: The path to the benchmark application directory used for tracing or simulation.
_scarab_path: A private clone, so sci's in-place hash checkout cannot disturb a working checkout.
_traces_dir: The local directory containing all simpointed traces, resolved as <traces_dir>/<suite>/<subsuite>/<workload>.
_top_simpoint: false: the simpoints are listed by cluster_id in simulations, or every simpoint of a workload. N: each workload's N heaviest simpoints, weights renormalized.
_simulations: sierra.a.4, whiskey, delta from mlp_oracle_google_defmark, same simpoints and lengths.
_configurations: Binary: c4ae7e61 2026-11-14 Merge pull request #47 from matthewpipie/sync-upstream-46. Marking on every config: --mlp_data_bound 3 --mlp_data_bound_min 16 --mlp_lin_data_thresh 0.0 --mlp_instr_mark 2 --mlp_lin_instr_thresh 0.7 --mlp_instr_starve 2 --mlp_instr_starve_min 1 (set by --marking: none). Machine flags on every config: none. --inst_limit is warmup + measured; it overrides the run script's cap at the trace length.

ctrl_i_ro_s1._params: Control, instruction: as many random non-cold reference misses as oracle_i_ro forces, on as many lines. Drawn with --mlp_oracle_seed 1 (the main study's is seed 0).

ctrl_d_ro_s1._params: Control, data: as many random non-cold reference misses as oracle_d_ro forces, on as many lines. Drawn with --mlp_oracle_seed 1 (the main study's is seed 0).

ctrl_b_ro_s1._params: Control, both sides: as many random non-cold reference misses as oracle_b_ro forces, on as many lines. Drawn with --mlp_oracle_seed 1 (the main study's is seed 0).

_visualize: ./sci --visualize plots IPC per workload against lru; tools/mlp_oracle/report.py gives the bounds.
